name: FR34KS
source:
Get to know the Freaks!

Welcome to the Summer Camp of Freaville, where problematic young adults from nearby universities are brought together for the summer.

Everyone has their secrets, both dark and bright sides, and it's up to you which side you get to know, based on your choices.

[From [url=https://bliss34.itch.io/fr34ks]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
认识一下怪胎吧！

欢迎来到弗雷维尔夏令营，来自附近大学的有问题的年轻人聚集在一起过暑假。

每个人都有自己的秘密，既有黑暗的一面，也有光明的一面，你要了解哪一面，取决于你的选择。

[来自[url=https://bliss34.itch.io/fr34ks]Itch.io[/url]]
